items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: that band I had, the first band I had... Dejon, the man I told you that knew so much music... he could just make up a piece and everybody would dance and play it

ctx.x: I don't think. I think they just stand up and play.

Well, that band I had, the first band I had, the old boys could do that. I mean, anything they hear, they could just go ahead and play. In fact, when we first started, everybody could just, well, Dejon, the man I told you that knew so much music and couldn't explain it, one would play a dance that way, he could just make up a piece and everybody would dance and play it and give it any name.
